scripts.test:integration: pnpm docker:up:infra && docker compose stop purchase-worker reconcile-stock-worker && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm --filter backend exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.docker:up:infra: docker compose up -d --build postgres redis rabbitmq
scripts.monitor:db: watch -n1 "docker exec flash-sale-postgres psql -U postgres -d flash_sale -c \"SELECT state, LEFT(COALESCE(wait_event_type, ''), 17) AS wait_event_type, LEFT(COALESCE(wait_event, ''), 25) AS wait_event, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='flash_sale' GROUP BY state, wait_event_type, wait_event ORDER BY count(*) DESC;\""
